title: dspm local and remote CLI output (OVCPR v1)
description: Validates an individual query response, mutation NDJSON record, or root version response. NDJSON validation applies separately to each record. Event ordering, completion, and cross-field constraints are specified in ../interoperability.md. Additional properties support additive extensions. Additional event types require an updated schema.

version.description: The value contains four nonnegative decimal integer components. Each component must fit a Go int. Version comparison requires numeric component comparison. Package and manifest versions use this representation independently of the executable version.

hash.description: The value is the lowercase SHA-512 content tree digest derived from package file paths and contents.

directory.description: The value is lowercase hexadecimal SHA-256 of UTF-8(id + '=' + normalized version). It names an immediate child of the package root.

text.description: The object retains all language keys and explicit empty strings. The key '_' identifies the default value.

filePaths.description: Each localized value is a nonempty, fully qualified, lexically normalized host path in the package read context. Each reference must identify a regular file inside the package.

diagnostics.description: Envelope diagnostics and packing summary diagnostics can be null or a string array, including an empty array.

dependency.description: The object identifies a declared dependency target. It does not identify the resolved compatible provider version.

contributionSummary.description: The object represents an indexed contribution. Singer summaries can include extracted declaration fields and names. Opaque summaries contain category and ID only.

installedAt.description: The value is the installation Unix timestamp in seconds.

singer.description: The object contains extracted singer resource strings and can be empty. Resource paths, media formats, and referenced files are not validated.

moduleMetadata.description: The object contains all required common module metadata fields. It represents successful extraction rather than a partial result.

entry.description: The object retains the expanded desc.json contribution entry and arbitrary fields. A non-string path in an opaque entry remains uninterpreted category data.

manifest.description: The object contains the singer declaration. The expanded flag distinguishes expanded metadata from a raw declaration retained after expansion failure. The field is absent for opaque contributions.

expanded.description: The value indicates successful singer declaration expansion. The field is absent for opaque contributions.

metadataError.description: The value reports failed variable expansion or unavailable required singer metadata fields. All three common module fields are absent in this failure state. The field is absent after successful extraction and for opaque contributions.

name.description: The object contains the extracted singer name or the contribution ID if no name is declared. The field is absent for opaque contributions.

interface.description: The value is an interface ID extracted from singer metadata.

level.description: The value is a positive singer API level.

variant.description: The value is a variant ID extracted from singer metadata.

url.description: The value is the website string after variable expansion. An explicit empty string is retained. The field is omitted if absent.

manifest.description: The object contains expanded desc.json with vars removed. Arbitrary package fields and JSON types are retained. Source formatting is not retained.

error.description: The code identifies a local, remote, download, cache, or publication failure specified in ../interoperability.md. Unknown codes require generic failure handling. AMBIGUOUS_VERSION details contain an array of canonical package selectors.

queryFailure.description: Argument and command setup errors can identify the root command dspm or the selected subcommand.

packSummary.description: The dryRun field is present and true for a packing dry run. Normal packing summaries omit dryRun.

downloadSize.description: The value is the exact compressed archive size in bytes.
The value is the exact compressed archive size in bytes.
